text:
acme_procurement: Hi team — procurement won't allow an invoice to be issued until we provide an official PO that contains their internal fields. They specifically require: cost center, requisition number, signed SOW reference, and an authorization code from Finance. Also need VAT-compliant billing info (VAT ID). Can you confirm you can hold billing?

omar_support: Thanks — we can place the invoice on hold. Can you paste the exact PO format they expect? small differences (like uppercase vs hyphen) break their upload.

acme_procurement: Sure — here's the sample they need (exact):
```
PO_NUMBER: REQ-2026-4578
COST_CENTER: IT-ENG-03
REQ_ID: 88991234
AUTH_CODE: FIN-AUTH-42
SOW_REF: SOW-Redwood-2026-v3-signed.pdf
VAT_ID: GB999888777
CONTACT: procurement@acme.example.com
```
They also said the SOW must be signed by our CFO or their procurement team will reject.

lucy_billing: Copying. Confirming Redwood policy: for enterprise customers with PO mandates we cannot finalize a standard invoice without an official PO reference. We can create a pro-forma invoice to be used for internal approval if that helps.

sam_account_exec: FYI legal needs to confirm signature chain on the SOW. @acme_procurement can you upload the signed SOW to the shared drive or attach to ticket #CUST-2109? that speeds things up.

acme_procurement: Uploading now to the link you provided. Can you also include the amount breakdown and VAT line on the pro-forma? they require line-level tax totals.

omar_support: Will do. Placing billing hold now and generating a pro-forma with line items + VAT. tagging @lucy_billing to finalize.

billing-bot: HOLD_CREATED: HOLD-PO-1779997777 — Invoice generation paused pending PO and signed SOW. Please reference this hold ID in ticket.

lucy_billing: Thanks — I'll produce the pro-forma with explicit VAT lines and the SOW reference. Once we get the PO_NUMBER and AUTH_CODE we will re-issue the final VAT invoice and clear the hold.

acme_procurement: Great — we aim to approve within 48 hours after SOW and pro-forma are in their system. Please confirm when pro-forma is uploaded.

omar_support: Pro-forma uploaded to ticket CUST-2109 and shared with your procurement email. Closing the loop: next steps for customer to remit final approval = upload PO (matching format above) + confirm AUTH_CODE. We'll keep the invoice on HOLD-PO-1779997777 until then. :white_check_mark:

sam_account_exec: I'll follow up with Legal to confirm signature validity and ping you once they confirm.

acme_procurement: Thanks all, appreciate the quick turnaround.
